decisions.reason: Shop relaunch SEO support builds directly on the firm's core expertise in shop relaunches and search marketing, it has been shown on its own page for two years, and the firm can readily interpret its results and improve it with existing knowledge.

SEO workshops draw on the firm's certified marketers and SEO know-how, so the firm can absorb client feedback and refine the format, and as a recently launched low-cost service it deserves more time to show results.
